name: Data Science
description: Turning raw data into answers: wrangling with pandas, exploration and visualisation, modelling and communicating results.

nodes.name: Data science workflow
nodes.desc: The iterative loop of asking a question, collecting and cleaning data, exploring, modelling and communicating.
nodes.summary: You will be able to follow the iterative data science loop from asking a question through cleaning, exploring and modelling to communicating results.

nodes.name: Notebooks
nodes.desc: Working in Jupyter notebooks: cells, kernels, inline plots and keeping analysis readable.
nodes.summary: You will be able to work productively in Jupyter notebooks with cells, kernels and inline plots while keeping analysis readable.

nodes.name: NumPy arrays
nodes.desc: Vectorised computation with ndarrays: shapes, broadcasting, indexing and aggregation.
nodes.summary: You will be able to compute with NumPy ndarrays using shapes, broadcasting, indexing and vectorised aggregations.

nodes.name: pandas DataFrames
nodes.desc: Series and DataFrames, selecting rows and columns, dtypes and basic summaries.
nodes.summary: You will be able to create and inspect pandas Series and DataFrames, select rows and columns and summarise data.

nodes.name: Getting data
nodes.desc: Loading data from CSV, JSON, Excel, web APIs and SQL databases into DataFrames.
nodes.summary: You will be able to load data from CSV, JSON, Excel, web APIs and SQL databases into pandas DataFrames.

nodes.name: Data cleaning
nodes.desc: Handling missing values, wrong types, duplicates, inconsistent categories and outliers.
nodes.summary: You will be able to clean messy data by handling missing values, wrong types, duplicates, inconsistent categories and outliers.

nodes.name: Reshape & merge
nodes.desc: groupby and aggregation, pivot and melt, and joining tables on keys.
nodes.summary: You will be able to aggregate with groupby, reshape with pivot and melt and join tables on keys in pandas.

nodes.name: Time series data
nodes.desc: Datetime indexes, resampling, rolling windows and handling time zones.
nodes.summary: You will be able to handle time series in pandas with datetime indexes, resampling, rolling windows and time zones.

nodes.name: Exploratory analysis
nodes.desc: Profiling a dataset: distributions, relationships, group comparisons and sanity checks.
nodes.summary: You will be able to profile a dataset by examining distributions, relationships and group comparisons and running sanity checks.

nodes.name: Visualisation
nodes.desc: Plotting with matplotlib and seaborn and choosing the right chart for the question.
nodes.summary: You will be able to plot data with matplotlib and seaborn and choose the right chart for the question being asked.

nodes.name: Feature engineering
nodes.desc: Encoding categories, scaling, binning, date parts and building informative derived features.
nodes.summary: You will be able to create informative features by encoding categories, scaling, binning, extracting date parts and deriving new columns.

nodes.name: EDA report
nodes.desc: Clean and explore a messy public dataset and write up the main findings with charts.
nodes.summary: You will clean and explore a messy public dataset and write up its main findings with clear charts.

nodes.name: scikit-learn models
nodes.desc: Fitting, validating and comparing models with scikit-learn pipelines and cross-validation.
nodes.summary: You will be able to fit, validate and compare models with scikit-learn pipelines and cross-validation.
topics: The estimator fit and predict API

nodes.name: A/B experiments
nodes.desc: Designing controlled experiments, choosing metrics and sample sizes, and reading the results.
nodes.summary: You will be able to design A/B experiments, choose metrics and sample sizes and interpret the statistical results.

nodes.name: Interpreting models
nodes.desc: Feature importance, partial dependence and SHAP values to explain what a model learned.
nodes.summary: You will be able to explain what a model learned using feature importance, partial dependence and SHAP values.

nodes.name: Prediction project
nodes.desc: Build, tune and explain a predictive model for a real dataset such as churn or prices.
nodes.summary: You will build, tune and explain a predictive model for a real dataset such as customer churn or house prices.

nodes.name: Data storytelling
nodes.desc: Structuring an analysis as a narrative for a non-technical audience.
nodes.summary: You will be able to structure an analysis as a clear narrative with visuals for a non-technical audience.

nodes.name: Dashboards
nodes.desc: Building interactive dashboards that track key metrics for stakeholders.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build interactive dashboards that track key metrics for stakeholders.

nodes.name: Reproducible analysis
nodes.desc: Version control, environments, parameterised notebooks and scripts others can rerun.
nodes.summary: You will be able to make analyses reproducible with version control, pinned environments, parameterised notebooks and rerunnable scripts.

nodes.name: Data ethics
nodes.desc: Privacy, consent, bias in data and models, and responsible reporting.
nodes.summary: You will be able to identify privacy, consent and bias issues in data and models and report results responsibly.

nodes.name: Data science capstone
nodes.desc: An end-to-end project from question to data to model to a published, reproducible report.
nodes.summary: You will complete an end-to-end project from question to data to model and publish a reproducible report.
